authorize.title: Sign in to Somtoday
authorize.description:
1. [Open the Somtoday sign-in page]({authorize_url}) in a new tab. Keep this setup open.

2. Before signing in, press F12. Open Network, enable Preserve log and select All.

3. Sign in. Find the last redirect: Headers → Response Headers → Location. Copy the entire value starting with `somtoday://`, including `code=` and `state=`. It may instead appear as a failed request or in Console. Do not copy the timetable URL or export a HAR.

4. Paste the full callback below. Do not share this temporary credential.

data.callback_url: Complete callback URL after signing in

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the school list or Somtoday.
error.invalid_auth: Somtoday did not accept the sign-in.
error.invalid_callback: Use the complete callback URL from this setup attempt, including code= and state=.
error.organization_not_found: The selected school organization is no longer available.
error.wrong_account: Sign in with the same Somtoday account and children as the existing integration.

abort.already_configured: This Somtoday account is already configured.
abort.sso_not_available: This school does not offer a supported SSO sign-in.
abort.reauth_successful: Somtoday sign-in renewed. Your entities and export settings have been retained.

init.title: Choose child
init.description: Choose the child whose calendar settings you want to change. Repeat for other children; synchronization settings apply to the whole account.

settings.title: Calendar settings
settings.description: Settings for {student}. Choose destination calendars and event titles on the next page. Calendar exports require write permissions.

data_description.enable_day: One event from the first lesson to the last.
data_description.enable_lessons: A separate event for each lesson.
data_description.enable_holidays: Published school holidays, using your chosen event layout.

data_description.days_ahead: Applies to every child in this account. Start with 1 day to verify your calendar exports.
data_description.scan_interval: How often to refresh Somtoday data. Applies to every child in this account.

destinations.title: Calendar destinations and titles
destinations.description: Set event titles and destination calendars for {student}. Automatic school-day naming also applies to this child’s HA calendar when exports are off. Export destinations require write permissions and support for event creation and deletion. Changing or disabling a destination leaves existing events in the old calendar. [Calendar setup and permissions]({help_url}).

data_description.holiday_mode: One event · Somtoday dates uses the published first and final school-free date. One event · include surrounding weekends expands that range to the Saturday before and Sunday after. One all-day event per Somtoday date creates a separate event for each published date. A continuous multi-week event also covers weekends inside its date range.
data_description.day_title: Placeholder: {student_placeholder}. Used unless automatic school-day naming supplies a shared activity title.
data_description.lesson_prefix: Placeholder: {student_placeholder}. Added before each lesson title.
data_description.automatic_day_title: Use the shared title when all active appointments on a day have the same non-empty title; ignore breaks and cancelled appointments. Otherwise use the normal school-day title. Remove text before the first underscore and replace remaining underscores with spaces: PREFIX_Special_activity becomes Special activity. Applies to this child’s HA school-day calendar and school-day export.

error.no_writable_calendars: No writable calendar is available. First add a calendar integration that supports creating and deleting events.

calendar_sync_failed.title: Somtoday calendar export needs attention
calendar_sync_failed.description: The destination calendar could not be synchronized. The source timetable remains available. Check the Calendar sync diagnostic sensor and destination calendar connection. Open the help link for provider permissions and recovery instructions.
